mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 3.0% and PAYEMS growth accelerates (> 200k new jobs), a tightening labor market fuels wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to anticipated inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, signaling improved industrial production, enhances corporate earnings prospects, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher in periods of INDPRO growth (t-test p > 0.10).

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) growth outpaces the previous month's, indicating strengthening consumer demand, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of months with RSAFS growth, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation rate) below 2.0% signals reduced pressure on the Fed to tighten, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate sustained accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when HOUST (housing starts) increases by more than 10% month-over-month and GDPC1 shows quarterly growth, a robust housing market and strong economic demand fuel positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST growth > 10% MoM and GDPC1 quarterly growth
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in UNRATE (> 0.5% in one month) signals labor market softening, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate potential Fed easing.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
